title: Himeji tourism bureau — Engyoji architecture and Three Halls

facts.fact: Mani-den uses kakezukuri construction suited to a steep slope, while Mitsu no Do is the distinct group of Daikodo, Shokudo and Jogyodo.
facts.location: Mani-den Hall and Mitsu no Do sections

facts.fact: The grounds were used for The Last Samurai; this does not mean unrestricted entry into every hall, which the bureau describes as having different public access.
The bureau explicitly notes that Juryoin's shojin ryori service ended in March 2025, so that dining experience must not be recommended as operating.
